title: Blender production build spec, v1
description: Declares, BEFORE detailing, what a physical part must measure. scripts/production-gate.py enforces it against a .blend. Every field is in millimetres. Passing the gate is DIGITAL evidence only: geometry, dimensions and screens. It is not load, fit-trial, thermal or slicer evidence.

schema_version.description: Spec schema version. Optional; the gate assumes 1.

units.description: REQUIRED. Only mm is accepted. Any other value is a contract error (exit 2).

project.description: Free text name of the build.

parts.description: REQUIRED. One entry per physical part to be manufactured.

fasteners.description: Bill of fasteners. Declared only: the gate does NOT check that a screw fits, only that declared hole diameters match the standard table.

load_cases.description: DECLARED ONLY. The gate never evaluates a load case; it copies them into report.exclusions so the omission is visible.

required_checks.description: Check names that MUST appear with status pass. A named check that did not run makes the gate fail (exit 1).

physical_evidence.description: DECLARED ONLY. Physical trials the owner still owes (print, fit, torque, heat). Copied into report.exclusions.

id.description: REQUIRED. Stable part id used in report.failed[].

object.description: REQUIRED. Exact Blender object name in the scene. Absent object => exit 2.

target_dims_mm.description: REQUIRED. World-space bounding-box X,Y,Z in mm.

tol_mm.description: REQUIRED. Symmetric tolerance on each bbox dimension.

process.description: Optional, e.g. FDM-0.4mm. Recorded, never checked.

orientation_up.description: Optional (default +z). Build axis used by the overhang screen.

min_wall_mm.description: Optional. Minimum material thickness. Enforced by a RAY SCREEN, not an exhaustive proof.

max_overhang_deg.description: Optional (default 45). Angle from the build axis beyond which a face counts as an overhang.

max_overhang_area_pct.description: Optional. If present the overhang screen becomes a gate; if absent it is reported as info only.

expected_shells.description: Optional (default 1). Number of separate closed surfaces the part must have.

features.description: Optional. Measured features. Anything not listed here is NOT measured.

type.description: REQUIRED. Only 'hole' is measured in v1; boss and slot are recorded and reported as unchecked.

center_mm.description: REQUIRED. A point on the feature axis, world mm.

depth_mm.description: Optional. Present => blind feature, depth is measured. Absent => through feature, the axial ray must exit.

tol_mm.description: REQUIRED. Symmetric tolerance on the measured diameter (and depth if declared).

keyed_flat_mm.description: Optional. Present => D-shaped (keyed) hole: nominal axis-to-flat distance. The diameter is then measured on the round part only and the flat is measured as its own check. Requires keyed_flat_dir.

keyed_flat_dir.description: Optional. Direction from the axis towards the flat ('x' | 'y' | 'z' or a 3-number direction, world). Required with keyed_flat_mm.

fastener.description: Optional. Makes the gate compare diameter_mm against a published table.

standard.description: ISO 273 / ISO 4762 => clearance hole. heatset => insert pilot hole.
